description: Initial global COVID-19 shock window, anchored at the WHO PHEIC declaration and ending at the WHO pandemic characterization.
source_note: Start anchor: WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 2020-01-30. End anchor: WHO characterized COVID-19 as a pandemic on 2020-03-11. Sources: https://www.who.int/europe/emergencies/situations/covid-19 ; https://www.who.int/news/item/27-04-2020-who-timeline---covid-19

description: Initial invasion shock window for Russia's 2022 full-scale invasion of Ukraine. The endpoint is a benchmark-defined first-shock cutoff, not a claim that the war ended.
source_note: Start anchor: United Nations Secretary-General statement on Ukraine, 2022-02-24. End anchor: benchmark-defined initial shock endpoint at the first full calendar month after invasion. Source: https://www.un.org/sg/en/content/sg/statement/2022-02-24/statement-the-secretary-general-ukraine

description: Initial shock window after the 2023-10-07 Hamas attack on Israel and the resulting war. The endpoint is benchmark-defined, not a claim that the conflict ended.
source_note: Start anchor: Israel Ministry of Foreign Affairs reports the attack began on 2023-10-07. End anchor: benchmark-defined 30-day initial shock window. Source: https://embassies.gov.il/italy/en/news/hamas-declares-war-israel-2023

description: June 2025 Israel-Iran escalation window, including U.S. involvement near the end of the twelve-day conflict.
